w-window-agg.detail: irstream theString/sum(intPrimitive)/window(*) over length(2) window; eviction posts one old row per leaving event with plain columns from the leaving event and aggregates over post-removal state

named-window-window.detail: keepall named window consumer with irstream theString/window(intPrimitive); insert posts only a new row, on-delete posts only the leaving row with the post-removal window

notes: Java ResultSetProcessorRowForAll mixed-shape irstream contract: a select that reads the current event outside aggregates emits an old row only per leaving event (window eviction or named-window delete), never on first insert; aggregate columns evaluate over post-removal state.
